item.title: Diesel reaches record $6 a gallon as Houthis seize key Red Sea territory
item.description: U.S. diesel prices have reached a new high of $6 a gallon, as reports said Houthi rebels in Yemen captured key territory along the Red Sea.

item.title: Backlash grows against Kevin O'Leary's large Utah data center project

item.title: Trump defends proposed $5,000 dividend as 'reward,' says 'growth' will fund it
